data.body: Phase 1 RCA confirmed on current origin/main d05bf2bc1be. Dynamic trace: 100 `_convert("hello", pandoc)` calls produced identical `hello` bytes and launched 202 subprocesses: 100 Pandoc plus 102 `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`. `_convert` obtains `communicate(..., timeout=_pandoc_timeout())` at wiki_render.py:393; `_pandoc_timeout` calls `load_config()` at :346; `load_config` invokes `repo_root(root)` before its result-cache lookup at config.py:393; implicit `repo_root` shells out at _config_sources.py:30-53. Resolving `_pandoc_timeout()` once and supplying that constant to the same 100 conversions produced byte-identical results with 103 subprocesses: 100 Pandoc plus 3 one-time root probes. Wall was 3.3395s -> 3.3057s locally (0.0338s saved); the process-count reduction, not this quiet-host timing, is the contention-safe proof. The earlier complete oracle trace observed 884 Pandoc + 886 root-discovery launches. This rules out Pandoc output generation, corpus cardinality, and mutation testing as causes of these extra processes. Defect legitimacy: explicit session contract requires reducing CI work without test-fidelity/behavioral coverage loss; repeated repository discovery is not part of any render assertion and 3/3 maintained OSS examples resolve loop/session-invariant configuration once. Caller sweep found `_render_unit` as the sole production caller and hardening tests as the only direct callers; all depend on timeout value/output behavior, none on the number of config lookups. Expected post-fix behavior is identical bytes/fallback/reaping with config sampled once per render pass and once per standalone direct call. No behavioral dependency blocks repair.
